She and [[Dulse]] play a central role in {{pkmn|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Pokémon Ultra Sun}}. ==In the core series games== ===Role=== {{incomplete|section}} ====Pokémon Ultra Sun==== Zossie is encountered several times with [[Dulse]] during the player's travel across Alola. As with the other members of the [[Ultra Recon Squad]], Zossie is initially amazed by Alola's [[Pokémon]] and the player's [[Z-Power Ring]], in her search for a way to stop [[Necrozma]]'s awakening. Zossie and [[Dulse]] don't formally introduce themselves to the player until they meet in [[Verdant Cavern]]. ====Pokémon Ultra Moon==== Zossie stays behind with Dulse in Ultra Megalopolis while [[Phyco]] and [[Soliera]] are investigating Alola. She is first encountered upon the player's arrival to Ultra Megalopolis. When spoken to, she will help summon a {{p|Solgaleo}} or {{p|Lunala}}, depending on the player's request, to return the player to Alola. ==Gallery== {{missing image|section|needs=needs high-poly model from Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon (used within cutscenes)}} ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{night color}}; background: #{{night color light}}; font-size: 80%" |style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{night color}}; background: #E88058"| [[File:Zossie USUM concept art.png|300px]] |- style="color:#fff;" | Concept art from

{{color2|fff|Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Zossie/Quotes}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Zossie Adventures.png|thumb|120px|Zossie in Pokémon Adventures]] Zossie debuted in ''[[PASM26|Adventure in the Dark Dimension]]''. She and [[Dulse]] arrived at the [[Ultra Deep Sea]] after [[Ultra Warp Ride|riding]] on {{p|Lunala}}. Dulse had just left the [[Alola]] region after meeting with the [[Aether Foundation]] to create [[Beast Ball|Poké Balls]] that could capture [[Ultra Beast]]s. Overhearing this fact, {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} approached the [[Ultra Recon Squad]] members and asked what their connection to the Aether Foundation was. After explaining themselves, Zossie and Dulse were asked by Moon if they could take her and Sun back to Alola. Though Dulse refused, Lunala went to Sun and Moon, as it was already acquainted with them. Having no choice, Dulse stayed behind while Zossie, Sun, and Moon rode on Lunala's back to Alola. Along the way, Zossie taught Sun how to use Ultra Warp Ride and told him and Moon about the various worlds the Ultra Beasts come from. After passing through an [[Ultra Wormhole]], the three arrived at the Ultra Recon Squad's home world, the [[Ultra Megalopolis]]. In ''[[PASM28|Arrival at the Scientific Megalopolis]]'', a {{p|Stakataka}} appeared, looking to battle {{p|Necrozma}}. As the citizens fled to safety, Zossie took Sun and Moon to the Ultra Recon Squad's headquarters in the [[Megalo Tower]]. There, they encountered [[Soliera]], who revealed she lured Stakataka in hopes of testing to see if the bonds between Trainers and their Pokémon could lead to a solution that would restore light to the Ultra Megalopolis. Zossie and Soliera then watched as Sun and Moon battled Stakataka and won. The battle alerted Necrozma, who released {{p|Solgaleo}} from its control and leapt off of the Megalo Tower to try and absorb Lunala as well. Sun and Moon tried to assist Lunala, but were stopped by [[Lusamine]]. A comment from Sun angered Lusamine, who sent out a {{p|Nihilego}} and had it fuse with her. In ''[[PASM31|Ray of Light!! Through the Crack in the Sky!]]'', Necrozma fled to the top of Megalo Tower while Lusamine chased after it. Zossie and the others tried pursuing them, but were sucked into an [[Ultra Wormhole]] Necrozma created, dropping everyone into the skies above [[Mount Lanakila]]. Zossie and the others later witnessed Necrozma battling against Zygarde in its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Complete Forme}}. During the clash, Necrozma opened a wormhole, summoning Dulse to Alola. It absorbed the [[Ultranecrozium Z]] Dulse had with him, allowing Necrozma to transform into Ultra Necrozma. The Ultra Recon Squad decided the best option to stop Necrozma was to capture it, but due to Lusamine's meddling, there were no Beast Balls left to use. [[Nanu]] stated he could have another Beast Ball delivered, but told Sun and Zygarde to keep Necrozma busy while they waited for it to arrive. Later, Moon joined in the battle, and with a combined attack from Zygarde, Lunala, and Solgaleo, Necrozma was finally downed. [[Anabel]] arrived with the final Beast Ball, but it was destroyed when Necrozma launched one final attack. Sun revealed he picked up the Beast Ball Moon tried using on Lusamine earlier, which Anabel decided to let Zossie use. Zossie captured Necrozma with the Beast Ball, hoping that it could one day be healed of its injured state. {{-}} ====Pokémon==== =====Befriended===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Zossie |pkmn=Poipole |type1=Poison |img=Ultra Recon Squad Poipole Adventures.png |epnum=PASM27 |epname=Meeting the Ultra Recon Squad |desc=This {{p|Poipole}} is close to the Ultra Recon Squad and follows them around. It was first used by Zossie to battle against {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}}, which it easily won due its opponents being distracted. None of Poipole's moves are known.}} =====Used===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Zossie |pkmn=Lunala |main=Nebby |type1=Psychic |type2=Ghost |img=Ultra Recon Squad Lunala Adventures.png |epnum=PASM04 |epname=The Decision and the Tournament of Six |desc=Zossie and Dulse used {{p|Lunala}} to travel through [[Ultra Space]] via [[Ultra Warp Ride]]. Due to Zossie's inexperience at piloting Lunala, she accidentally caused it to crash-land in the [[Ultra Deep Sea]]. After reuniting with {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}}, Lunala left Zossie and Dulse to go back to its companions.}} =====Caught for the Ultra Recon Squad===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ultra Recon Squad |main=Necrozma (Adventures) |pkmn=Necrozma |type1=Psychic |type2=Dragon |img=Ultra Necrozma Adventures.png |epnum=PASM25 |epname=Summon the Emissaries of the Moon and the Sun |desc={{p|Necrozma}} is a Pokémon worshiped by the people of the [[Ultra Megalopolis]] as the Blinding One. Necrozma attacked Alola in an attempt to steal its light and restore itself to its former glory.
